verses.text: Praise the LORD! Praise his name! Praise him, all you who serve the LORD,
you who stand in the LORD’s house, in the courts of our God’s house.
Praise the LORD, because he’s good. Sing praise to his name, because it’s a joy to do it.
The LORD chose Jacob for himself. He made Israel his own.
I know the LORD is great. Our Lord is above every god.
The LORD does whatever he wants, in heaven and on earth, in the seas and in the deepest waters.
He brings clouds up from the ends of the earth, sends lightning with the rain, and lets the wind out of his storehouses.
He struck down Egypt’s firstborn, both people and animals.
He sent signs and wonders right into the middle of Egypt, against Pharaoh and all his servants.
He struck down many nations and killed powerful kings,
Sihon king of the Amorites, Og king of Bashan, and all the kingdoms of Canaan.
He gave their land as an inheritance to Israel, his own people.
Your name lasts forever, LORD. Every generation will know what you’ve done.
The LORD will judge his people and have compassion on his servants.
The nations’ idols are silver and gold, made by human hands.
They have mouths that can’t speak and eyes that can’t see.
They have ears that can’t hear, and there’s no breath in their mouths.
Those who make them will end up like them, and so will everyone who trusts them.
Family of Israel, praise the LORD! Family of Aaron, praise the LORD!
Family of Levi, praise the LORD! Everyone who fears the LORD, praise him!
Blessed be the LORD from Zion, the one who lives in Jerusalem. Praise the LORD!
